hooks.name: Local Secret Scan (pre-commit)
hooks.description: Syncs auth layer, then runs local regex secret scanner on staged files. Blocks commit if secrets found.

action.command: bash -c 'cd /home/peter/projects/myAdmin && src="backend/shared/auth_utils.py" && dst="backend/layers/auth-layer/python/shared/auth_utils.py" && if [ -f "$src" ] && [ -f "$dst" ]; then if [ "$(md5sum "$src" | cut -d" " -f1)" != "$(md5sum "$dst" | cut -d" " -f1)" ]; then cp "$src" "$dst" && git add "$dst" && echo "Auth layer synced"; fi; fi && ./scripts/scan-secrets-local.sh'
